name: titan-receipts
description: Know which commits AI wrote, and prove the record wasn't rewritten. Every commit gets a tamper-evident receipt: AI-assisted or not, model, Claude Code version, session, file and diff hashes; hash-chained, HMAC-signed, verified offline. Run /receipt-init once per repo. /receipt-report writes change-control evidence to hand your SOC 2 / HIPAA / PCI auditor.
